tonight.headline: Claims lock at 01:00 — and Achane is still starting
body: Week 4 hasn't started. ESPN has you at 114.0 against Aye-Aye's 125.2, a 45% chance, and that counts Achane's zero in an RB slot. Tuten in his place takes the lineup to 126.7.

Tonight is the last chance before claims process at 01:00 Wednesday Mexico City: make sure the Gordon claim is submitted, and swap Tuten in for Achane. After that, Wednesday-to-Friday practice decides Jefferson, Coker and Allen.

case.label: The swing
case.body: Tuten's 12.7 for Achane's 0.0 is worth more than any other decision this week. Nothing else in the lineup differs from the projection.

case.label: The risk
case.body: Three starters are questionable: Allen (knee contusion, Chao expects no missed time), Jefferson (ankle, 'got close' to returning Sunday) and Coker (quad, 'avoided serious injury'). None has practised yet.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A limited or DNP Wednesday for Jefferson. That's the first real evidence, and Friday decides whether McLaurin starts before 07:30 Sunday.

tonight.caseSources: ESPN league file · SI · Athlon · NBC

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Claims process Wed 01:00 Mexico City — tonight
doFirst.title: Claim Ollie Gordon II, drop Achane
doFirst.subtitle: Carried from Monday and still right. AVIATO is 1st in the order, so a submitted claim wins. The window closes overnight.

case.label: The role
case.body: Gordon took Miami's backfield once Achane went down: 18 carries, a goal-line TD and 3 catches against Kansas City (Heavy, 28 Sep). The archive has him at 14.5 points on 17 carries and 3 targets. He left briefly with cramps and returned.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Achane is 88.5% rostered, so this goes against the market on the record, for one reason: a torn ACL ends his season (NFL.com/CBS, 28 Sep) and Chem has no IR slot. He holds a roster spot and can't score.

case.label: The contested part
case.body: Jaylen Wright (stinger, foot) is day-to-day and aiming for Week 4, and The Big Lead ranks him the better add. He hasn't practised yet. I take Gordon: he has the job now and Wright's return is unconfirmed. Gordon is depth here, not a starter over Warren or Tuten.

case.label: The order
case.body: Swap Tuten in for Achane before the claim runs, so the claim doesn't leave an empty RB slot. Chem's priority resets weekly, so the claim costs nothing lasting. ESPN doesn't show pending claims, so check it's actually submitted.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Wright returns and Gordon draws under 12 touches in Week 4, which makes it a timeshare. Or Monangai outscores Gordon in two of Weeks 4–6.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Before Sun 11:00 (Tuten's kickoff) — do it now
doFirst.title: Start Tuten in Achane's RB slot
doFirst.subtitle: Achane is out for the season and still in your starting lineup. 12.7 projected points for one tap. Still not done as of the 18:18 snapshot.

case.label: The trigger
case.body: Last week's ghost card, fired. Achane tore his ACL (NFL.com/CBS, 28 Sep); he's INJURY_RESERVE in the file and still in slot 2.

case.label: Why Tuten
case.body: Jacksonville's lead back: 15, 13, 15 carries and 30 of 62 snaps in Week 3 against Rodriguez's 13 (NBC, 27 Sep). He projects 12.7, ahead of Kamara (10.6) and Monangai (8.4) by more than the two-point coin-flip line.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Kamara or Monangai outscores Tuten in Week 4. Graded on the archive's result.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · decide on Friday's report, before Sun 07:30
doFirst.title: If Jefferson is OUT or DOUBTFUL Friday: start McLaurin
doFirst.subtitle: The fallback the tool printed can't wait for Sunday's inactives. McLaurin kicks off in London at 07:30, five hours before Jefferson's 12:35 check.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Right-ankle sprain; MRI showed no structural damage and O'Connell said he 'got close' to returning Sunday. The issue is swelling (Athlon, 29 Sep; ESPN/NBC, 28 Sep). Wednesday to Friday practice decides.

case.label: The timing problem
case.body: lineup_check.py names McLaurin as the fallback at 12:35 Sunday, but Washington play Indianapolis in London at 07:30, and Boston plays Thursday. So the WR decision has to be made on Friday's report.

case.label: If he's questionable and sits
case.body: At 12:35, move Coker from FLEX to WR and put Kamara (Monday night) in the FLEX. Kamara is the only bench player still unlocked by then.

case.label: Why McLaurin
case.body: Nine targets in each of the last two weeks, 41% of Washington's in Week 3, 6-77-1 with Mariota. Mariota is the likely starter: Daniels travels with a dislocated elbow, 'far from certain' (RotoWire, 29 Sep).

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The card fires and Jefferson plays after all. Or it fires and McLaurin is outscored by the player he replaced.

action.label: Start McLaurin · bench Jefferson (only if OUT/DOUBTFUL Friday)

doFirst.urgency: Only if Allen is ruled out
doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · only if Allen is ruled out · by Sun 09:30
doFirst.title: If Allen is ruled out: add Kyler Murray, drop Monangai
doFirst.subtitle: Every report says Allen plays. But there's no QB behind him on this roster, so the plan has to exist before Sunday.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Left-knee contusion. Dr. David Chao: no significant MCL injury, 'hurt, not injured', no missed time expected (SI, 29 Sep). The Bills' first practice report is Wednesday.

case.label: Why Murray
case.body: Minnesota's named starter, cleared the concussion protocol before Week 3 (MPR). He projects 19.5 and is on waivers until Wed 01:00, then free if nobody claims him. Mariota (18.6) is second, but Daniels may return.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Monangai: ten carries, no targets in Week 3, fifth back once Tuten starts.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Allen is active Sunday and the card never fires. That's the expected outcome.

action.label: Add Murray · drop Monangai (only if Allen is out)

whatWentWrong.title: Achane is still in the lineup, eleven hours after this morning's card
whatWentWrong.lead: The 18:18 snapshot still has him in slot 2. That's the 12.7-point gap in tonight's matchup, and the Gordon claim should run after the swap, not before.

case.label: The file
case.body: Lineup as set 114.0, projection lineup 126.7. The only difference is Achane's 0.0 against Tuten's 12.7.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: The swap made. Then this row disappears.

whatWentWrong.title: Lost 103.8 to 140.6, with 34.1 left on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: The best lineup from this roster scored 137.9 and still lost by 2.7. Three of the gaps were injury exits.

case.label: The archive
case.body: Started 103.8. Best available 137.9: Tuten (17.0) for Achane (1.7), McLaurin (19.7) for Jefferson (5.2), Boston (8.1) for Coker (3.8). Achane, Jefferson and Coker all left injured, so those swaps can't be graded as lineup errors. The Coker-over-McLaurin thesis was already closed WRONG on outcome.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Nothing about the method: this week's lineup is the projection lineup with no thesis on any coin flip. It does say the Sunday fallbacks matter, which is why both WR plans are written down.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A lineup call this week that departs from the projection without unpriced news. None is proposed.

whatWentWrong.title: Both WR fallbacks lock before Sunday's inactives
whatWentWrong.lead: Boston plays Thursday and McLaurin at 07:30 in London. Jefferson's inactives come at 12:35 and Coker's at 16:50.

case.label: Why it matters
case.body: The tool's contingencies name McLaurin and Boston; both would be locked when they're needed. The brief corrects it: Friday's report for Jefferson, Kamara in the flex for Coker.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jefferson practising in full by Friday, which leaves only the Coker plan live.

worthALook.name: Jordan Addison
worthALook.lead: Minnesota's WR1 for as long as Jefferson sits. Not a claim tonight.

case.label: The role
case.body: 5-90-1 on 9 targets with Jefferson out, including a deep TD from Murray (Athlon, 29 Sep). The archive has him at 20.0.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 2 and 5 targets in Weeks 1–2 with Jefferson healthy. The role is Jefferson's absence, and Jefferson 'got close' to playing Sunday.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Jefferson OUT beyond Week 4. He'd be a free agent after 01:00 if nobody claims him tonight.

worthALook.name: Braelon Allen
worthALook.lead: The Jets' lead back while Breece Hall is out. A coin flip with Tuten, and no seat.

case.label: The role
case.body: Hall (quad) is week-to-week; the MRI was 'not as significant as feared' but he's likely to miss Week 4, and Braelon Allen leads with Isaiah Davis behind (NFL.com 28 Sep; LastWordOnSports 29 Sep). The wire screen has him inheriting 76% of the share.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 4 carries for 14 yards in Week 3, and a 12.8 projection that sits 0.1 above Tuten's. He'd be a third back here, and the only seat is Monangai's steady ten carries.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Hall is ruled out past Week 5, or Monangai loses his share to a Bears QB change.

case.label: When to act

waiverAnalysis.summary: Two risers, no fallers, from three weeks of data, which is still thin. Neither has a role reason that makes a move: one is a handcuff and the other is one game of a demotion in Jacksonville. The Gordon claim comes from injury news, not from this tool.

rising.roleReason: Atlanta's clear backup: 19 snaps to Bijan Robinson's 51 in Week 3 (Yahoo, 28 Sep); Bijan is healthy. A handcuff, not a breakout.

cannotSee.label: Rival claims
cannotSee.body: ESPN returns only your own pending claims, and the file doesn't show whether yours is submitted. AVIATO is first in the order, so a submitted Gordon claim should win.

cannotSee.label: Practice
cannotSee.body: No Sunday team has practised for Week 4. Allen, Jefferson and Coker rest on Monday–Tuesday medical reporting. Wednesday is the first evidence.

cannotSee.body: Grades use footballdb's points allowed through three games, scoring format not stated, and its QB table lists 31 teams. McLaurin, Monangai, Boston and Kamara face defences outside the pull and are dashed.

cannotSee.body: lineup_check.py picks fallbacks by projection and ignores their kickoff. Two of its three Chem fallbacks are unusable this week; the brief corrects them by hand.
